_what: Repo-tracked ingest settings. scripts/ingest-history.mjs reads this file on every run, because the GitHub App token that automates this repository is NOT permitted to modify .github/workflows/* (HTTP 403 on workflow dispatch, and a ruleset blocks workflow-file pushes). Anything that must be configurable without editing a workflow belongs here.

_schema.intraday.enabled: boolean — when true, every daily run also performs a second pass at the given period_interval
_schema.intraday.days: backfill window in days when the intraday store is empty
_schema.intraday.max_bars: keep only the newest N bars per market (0 = unbounded); trimming is recorded in store.trims
_schema.intraday.tickers: explicit markets. Kept short on purpose: intraday bars are ~24x as many rows as daily bars

intraday._why_these: Curated by LIFETIME CONTRACT VOLUME reported by the exchange (market.volume_fp in the daily store, see data/history/_manifest.json): the ten highest-volume KXBTCY strikes (the fee-free series; 2.0M-2.7M contracts each) plus KXNASDAQ100Y-26DEC31H1600-T19000 (1.27M) and KXINXY-26DEC31H1600-B8100 (507k). 12 markets x <=336 hourly bars keeps the store near 2 MB and the browser module near 400 KB, and the universe is described by a rule rather than by preference.
intraday._why_not_all: The first intraday run inherited the daily run's --series flag and ingested all 117 open markets of the three series (40,039 bars, 22 MB, ~1.3 MB/day of growth, ~630 HTTP requests per run, mostly zero-volume strikes). scripts/prune-intraday.mjs removed them and recorded every one in data/history/intraday/60m/_prune-ledger.json with its own restore command. inherit_cli_universe is now false by default.
